title: Lior and the Parish
author: Wendell Reyes
blurb: Odile Kavanagh, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
